cp10:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi sasako pavanacāriko tiṇapaṇṇasākaphalabhakkho paraheṭhanavivajjito, || ||
cp10:2.1: Makkaṭo ca sigālo ca uddapoto c' ahaṃ tadā vasāma ekasāmantā sāyaṃ pāto padissare. || ||
cp10:3.1: Ahaṃ te anusāsāmi kiriye kalyāṇapāpake: pāpāni parivajjetha kalyāṇe abhinivissatha. || ||
cp10:4.1: Uposathamhi divase candaṃ disvāna pūritaṃ etesaṃ tattha ācikkhiṃ: divaso ajj' uposatho. || ||
cp10:5.1: Dānāni paṭiyādetha dakkhiṇeyyassa dātave datvā dānaṃ dakkhiṇeyye upavassath' uposathaṃ. || ||
cp10:6.1: Te me sādhū 'ti vatvāna yathāsatti yathābalaṃ dānāni paṭiyādetvā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesisuṃ. || ||
cp10:7.1: Ahaṃ nisajja cintesiṃ dānaṃ dakkhiṇ' anucchavaṃ yadi' haṃ labhe dakkhiṇeyyaṃ kim-me dānaṃ bhavissati. || ||
cp10:8.1: Na me atthi tilā muggā māsā vā taṇḍulā ghataṃ ahaṃ tiṇena yāpemi na sakkā tiṇa dātave. || ||
cp10:9.1: Yadi eti dakkhiṇeyyo bhikkhāya mama santike dajjā' haṃ sakam-attānaṃ na so tuccho gamissati. || ||
cp10:10.1: Mama saṅkappam-aññāya Sakko brāhmaṇavaṇṇinā āsayam-me upāgañchi dānaṃ vīmaṃsanāya me. || ||
cp10:11.1: Tam-ahaṃ disvāna santuṭṭho idaṃ vacanam-abraviṃ sādhu kho 'si anuppatto ghāsahetu mam' antike. || ||
cp10:12.1: Adinnapubbaṃ dānavaraṃ ajja dassāmi te ahaṃ tuvaṃ sīlaguṇ' ūpeto ayuttan-te paraheṭhanaṃ. || ||
cp10:13.1: Ehi aggiṃ padīpehi nānākaṭṭhe samāniya ahaṃ pacissam-attānaṃ pakkaṃ tvaṃ bhakkhayissasi. || ||
cp10:14.1: Sādhū 'ti so haṭṭhamano nānākaṭṭhe samānayi mahantaṃ akāsi citakaṃ katvāna' ṅgāragabbhakaṃ. || ||
cp10:15.1: Aggiṃ tattha padīpesi yathā so khippaṃ mahā bhave phoṭetvā rajagate gatte ekam-antaṃ upāvisiṃ. || ||
cp10:16.1: Yadā mahākaṭṭhapuñjo āditto dhamadhamāyati tad-uppatitvā papatiṃ majjhe jālasikh' antare. || ||
cp10:17.1: Yathā sītodakaṃ nāma paviṭṭhaṃ yassa kassaci sameti darathapariḷāhaṃ assādaṃ deti pīti ca, || ||
cp10:18.1: Tath' eva jalitaṃ aggiṃ paviṭṭhassa mamaṃ tadā sabbaṃ sameti darathaṃ yathā sītodakaṃ viya. || ||
cp10:19.1: Chavicammaṃ maṃsaṃ nahāruṃ aṭṭhiṃ hadayabandhanaṃ kevalaṃ sakalaṃ kāyaṃ brāhmaṇassa adās' ahan-ti. || ||
cp10:23.1: Akitti-brāhmaṇo Saṅkho Kururājā Dhanañjayo Mahāsudassano rājā Mahāgovindabrāhmaṇo. || ||
cp10:24.1: Nimi Candakumāro ca Sivi Vessantaro saso aham-eva tadā āsiṃ yo te dānavare adā. || ||
cp10:25.1: Ete dānaparikkhārā ete dānassa pāramī jīvitaṃ yācake datvā imaṃ pārami pūrayiṃ. || ||
cp10:26.1: Bhikkhāya upagataṃ disvā saka 'ttānaṃ pariccajiṃ; dānena me samo natthi esā me dānapāramīti.
